breakpoint.$description: Viewport widths where layout changes. Read as min-width/max-width in @media — CSS custom properties can't be used inside a media query, so builders resolve these to literal px at build time. Added 2026-10-26 with Modal's mobile sheet; the first breakpoint in the system.

md.$description: 768px — below this the viewport is a phone (or a small tablet in portrait): Modal md/lg/xl take Drawer's bottom placement. The same 768 the CX and Message Center prototypes already switched Drawer↔Modal at; named md after the common scale (Tailwind md = 768).
